slices.title: Knowledge-mode receipt and badge
slices.summary: Adds an optional knowledge block (mode retrieval, not_entitled or not_searched, plus a source count) to the existing source_scope_applied SSE event, built by a pure knowledge_receipt function, and a knowledge chip on Space turns in the SPA. An absent block means today's behaviour; retrieval_notice is not reused.

slices.title: ZDR rows, contract tests and flip evidence
slices.summary: Adds the three browser ZDR posture rows (browser_do_tools_refused_under_zdr, browser_bearer_zdr_not_forwarded, browser_login_refused_under_zdr) to zdr-posture-matrix.json and its sha256, adds the browser_do_contract integration test, wires the two wire goldens into their consumers, and records source- and live-verified dates in MODEL_PLANE_STATUS.md. Flips follow the stated order: site policy shadow then enforce, execution-core flag on for an internal org, then default.
